directAnswer: You can move contacts to a new phone by syncing them with your Google or Apple account, or by using a transfer app specific to your phone model.
summary: Transferring contacts to a new phone can be done easily through cloud services or dedicated apps, depending on your device's operating system.

sections.heading: Syncing Contacts via Cloud Services
sections.body: Most smartphones allow you to sync contacts using cloud services like Google for Android devices or iCloud for iPhones. Ensure you are signed into your account on both the old and new devices.

sections.heading: Using Transfer Apps
sections.body: Many manufacturers offer their own transfer apps (e.g., Samsung Smart Switch, Apple Move to iOS) that facilitate the transfer of contacts and other data between devices.

sections.heading: Manual Transfer Options
sections.body: You can also manually export contacts from your old phone as a VCF file and then import it to your new phone.

steps.title: Sync Contacts with Google (Android)
steps.detail: On your old phone, go to Settings > Accounts > Google, select your account, and ensure Contacts sync is enabled. On your new phone, log into the same Google account to retrieve your contacts.

steps.title: Sync Contacts with iCloud (iPhone)
steps.detail: On your old iPhone, go to Settings > [your name] > iCloud and toggle on Contacts. On your new iPhone, sign in to iCloud with the same Apple ID to sync your contacts.

steps.title: Using Samsung Smart Switch
steps.detail: Download Smart Switch on both devices. Open the app on both phones, select 'Send data' on the old phone and 'Receive data' on the new phone, and follow the prompts to transfer contacts.

steps.title: Exporting and Importing Contacts
steps.detail: On your old phone, export your contacts to a VCF file via the Contacts app. Transfer the VCF file to your new phone and import it through the Contacts app.

faqs.question: What if I don't have internet access?
faqs.answer: You can still transfer contacts using a manual export/import method or by using a USB cable to connect both phones and transfer data directly.

faqs.question: Will transferring contacts also move my contact photos?
faqs.answer: It depends on the method used. Syncing with cloud services usually transfers contact photos, while manual exports may not include them.

faqs.question: Can I transfer contacts from a non-smartphone?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can typically export contacts from a non-smartphone to a CSV or VCF file and then import them to your new smartphone.

caveats: Ensure both devices are compatible with the chosen transfer method, as some apps may not work across different platforms.
